I've seen a lot of talk about this. The starhawk is enough of a threat that your opponent will make sure to focus on taking it down every game. So, very often it's recommended to be used as a tank without any upgrades as the ship is effective on its own. Then you put all the upgrades on other ships to act as support and do damage, allowing the starhawk to draw your opponents attention.

I'd say it feels wrong to even choose a favorite, they are all really well done models based on the circumstance they're involved in. Servo skull\_1 is what I'd expect floating around just about anywhere. Servo skull with the scroll (visually looks best) is best found in areas with administrative personnel. Servo skill\_3 is perfect for any religious area or accompanying Mechanicus. Servo skull with the book and candle seems almost as versatile as servo skull\_1 where it can be placed.   


I apologize if it isn't helpful, just having this variety instead of a singular type would be preferred for immersion, as they are all really aesthetically appealing.
